townHall.name: Town Hall
townHall.description: The north side of the loop. Clicking a landmark asks the navigation graph for a route and the walk is animated along it.

museum.name: Museum
museum.description: The east side. The whole scene shares one container sorted on grid depth, so whatever is nearer the camera is drawn last, water and pavement included.

market.name: Market Hall
market.description: The south side, and where the walker starts. Road tiles are generated from the same graph the walker routes over.

library.name: Library
library.description: The west side. Selection state lives in Redux, and the Pixi scene reads it rather than owning it.

splash.tagline: Follow the route, step by step.

scenario.title: Route
scenario.doneText: All {{count}} stops visited. Restart to walk it again.

welcome.title: Report to the Town Hall
welcome.description: The first stop. Head over and the walker takes the shortest route the road graph allows.

archive.title: Look through the archive
archive.description: The Museum holds the records. It opens once the first stop is behind you.

study.title: Spend an hour in the Library
study.description: Reading room on the west side of the loop, across the square from the Museum.

market.title: Meet the traders
market.description: The Market Hall closes the route, on the south side where the walk began.
